summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests memory-like natural killer (ML NK) cells given with nivolumab and relatlimab in advanced or metastatic melanoma that has progressed after treatment with checkpoint inhibitors. ML NK cells are given on Day 0, and nivolumab and relatlimab start at Day 29 and continue every 28 days for up to 11 cycles, or until unacceptable toxicity or progression. The study looks at safety, tolerability, and preliminary anti-tumor activity, and it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba células asesinas naturales de memoria (ML NK) junto con nivolumab y relatlimab en melanoma avanzado o metastásico que progresó después de tratamiento con inhibidores de puntos de control. Las células ML NK se administran el día 0, y nivolumab y relatlimab comienzan el día 29 y continúan cada 28 días por hasta 11 ciclos, o hasta toxicidad inaceptable o progresión. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la actividad temprana contra el tumor, y es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic melanoma that progressed after at least 12 weeks or at least 2 doses of a PD-1 or PD-L1 treatment.
ECOG performance status of 2 or better at screening.
Adequate liver, kidney, oxygen, and heart pumping function, as defined in the record.
not_for: Active autoimmune disease that requires immunosuppression.
Prior grade 3 or 4 immune-related side effect from cancer immunotherapy that led to stopping that treatment.
Symptomatic brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
Prior tumor infiltrating lymphocyte therapy or organ allograft.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or uncontrolled infection such as HIV or hepatitis B or C.
